playoff.note: 5th hosts 4th and 6th visits 3rd, both single matches; the final is one match hosted by the higher-placed club. The winner is the third promoted club.

boundaries.note: Pro League: bottom 3 (16th-18th) relegated directly, no play-off. First Division: top 2 direct, 3rd-6th play off for the third place (single-leg ties).

notes: Both levels are plain 18-club double round robins (34 rounds). The Pro League has no relegation play-off; the First Division's promotion play-off is single-leg, not two-legged. The Saudi Second Division (level 3) is not in our database, so SA2L is closed downward here although clubs really are relegated into it. 2026-27 Pro League runs 13 Aug 2026 - 29 May 2027 with a winter break for the 2027 AFC Asian Cup. Sponsored names: Roshn Saudi League (SA1), Yelo League (SA2L).
